short: Trustless Agent Identity, Reputation, and Validation Registries
introduction: ERC-8004 defines three on-chain registries that let autonomous agents be discovered and trusted across organizations without pre-existing trust. It was proposed by Marco De Rossi, Davide Crapis, Jordan Ellis, and Erik Reppel in August 2025. An ERC-721 Identity Registry gives each agent a portable identifier, a Reputation Registry stores client feedback, and a Validation Registry tracks validator checks. Note: ERC-8004 is a Draft; the specification is still under active development and may change substantially.
designPurpose: ERC-8004 was designed to fill a gap left by agent communication protocols such as MCP and A2A, which handle messaging and capability advertisement but not discovery or trust. Before it, there was no shared way to find an agent, verify who controls it, or judge its track record across organizations. It answers with three lightweight registries deployable as per-chain singletons: identity in a transferable ERC-721 token, reputation as on-chain feedback, and validation through re-execution or attestation hooks.
commonUsage: The registries target open agent marketplaces and explorers that crawl agents, read their registration files, and show the services, endpoints, and trust models each agent supports. Because identities are ERC-721 tokens, any NFT-compatible application can browse, transfer, and manage agents, while reputation and validation data live on-chain so scoring services, auditor networks, and insurance pools can aggregate feedback and verify work over shared public signals.
fn.register.desc: Mints a new agent as an ERC-721 token, assigning an incrementing agentId to the caller and resolving the token to the given registration file URI. Emits a Registered event.
fn.register.params.agentURI: The URI that resolves to the agent's off-chain registration file, such as an ipfs:// or https:// address.
fn.register.returns.agentId: The ERC-721 tokenId assigned incrementally to the newly registered agent.
fn.setAgentURI.desc: Updates the registration file URI of an existing agent and emits a URIUpdated event so indexers can refresh the agent's metadata.
fn.setAgentURI.params.agentId: The agent whose registration URI is being changed.
fn.setAgentURI.params.newURI: The new URI that resolves to the agent's registration file.
fn.setMetadata.desc: Stores an optional extra on-chain metadata value under a string key for an agent. The reserved agentWallet key cannot be set through this function.
fn.setMetadata.params.agentId: The agent the metadata entry belongs to.
fn.setMetadata.params.metadataKey: The string key identifying the metadata entry.
fn.setMetadata.params.metadataValue: The raw bytes value stored under the key.
fn.setAgentWallet.desc: Sets the agent's payment wallet after verifying control of the new address through an EIP-712 signature for EOAs or an ERC-1271 signature for smart contract wallets, valid until the given deadline.
fn.setAgentWallet.params.agentId: The agent whose payment wallet is being set.
fn.setAgentWallet.params.newWallet: The address that will receive the agent's payments.
fn.setAgentWallet.params.deadline: The timestamp after which the signature is no longer valid.
fn.setAgentWallet.params.signature: The EIP-712 or ERC-1271 signature proving control of the new wallet.
fn.giveFeedback.desc: Records a signed feedback signal about an agent from a client address, storing a fixed-point value with its decimals plus optional tags. The caller must not be the agent owner or an approved operator.
fn.giveFeedback.params.agentId: The registered agent the feedback is about.
fn.giveFeedback.params.valueDecimals: The number of decimal places in value, between 0 and 18.
fn.giveFeedback.params.tag1: An optional first tag categorizing the feedback.
fn.giveFeedback.params.tag2: An optional second tag categorizing the feedback.
fn.giveFeedback.params.endpoint: An optional endpoint URI the feedback relates to.
fn.giveFeedback.params.feedbackURI: An optional URI pointing to an off-chain file with additional feedback data.
fn.giveFeedback.params.feedbackHash: The optional KECCAK-256 hash of the feedbackURI content, omitted for content-addressed URIs such as IPFS.
fn.validationRequest.desc: Requests that a validator smart contract independently check an agent's work. Must be called by the owner or operator of the agent and emits a ValidationRequest event.
fn.validationRequest.params.validatorAdd: The validator contract asked to verify the work.
fn.validationRequest.params.agentId: The agent whose work is being validated.
fn.validationRequest.params.requestURI: The URI pointing to the off-chain data the validator needs.
fn.validationRequest.params.requestHash: The keccak256 commitment to the request payload, which also identifies the request.
fn.validationResponse.desc: Records a validator's response to a request as a value between 0 and 100. Must be called by the validator named in the request and may be called multiple times to update the status.
fn.validationResponse.params.requestHash: The identifier of the request being answered.
fn.validationResponse.params.response: The validation result, from 0 for failed to 100 for passed.
fn.validationResponse.params.responseURI: An optional URI pointing to off-chain evidence or an audit of the validation.
fn.validationResponse.params.responseHas: The optional keccak256 commitment to the responseURI content.
fn.validationResponse.params.tag: An optional tag for custom categorization, such as a finality stage.
fn.Registered.desc: Emitted when a new agent is minted, recording its agentId, registration URI, and owner.
fn.Registered.params.agentId: The tokenId of the newly registered agent.
fn.Registered.params.agentURI: The registration file URI assigned to the agent.
fn.Registered.params.owner: The address that owns the new agent token.
fn.NewFeedback.desc: Emitted when a client submits feedback, exposing the reputation signal and its tags on-chain while the endpoint and file references are emitted but not stored.
fn.NewFeedback.params.agentId: The agent the feedback is about.
fn.NewFeedback.params.clientAddress: The client address that submitted the feedback.
fn.NewFeedback.params.feedbackIndex: The 1-indexed counter of feedback this client has given the agent.
fn.NewFeedback.params.valueDecimals: The number of decimal places in value.
fn.NewFeedback.params.indexedTag1: The indexed copy of tag1, allowing logs to be filtered by tag.
fn.NewFeedback.params.endpoint: The optional endpoint URI the feedback relates to.
fn.NewFeedback.params.feedbackURI: The optional URI of the off-chain feedback file.
fn.NewFeedback.params.feedbackHash: The optional KECCAK-256 hash of the feedback file.
fn.ValidationRequest.desc: Emitted when an agent requests validation, recording the validator, agent, request URI, and request hash.
fn.ValidationRequest.params.validatorAdd: The validator contract asked to verify the work.
fn.ValidationRequest.params.agentId: The agent whose work is being validated.
fn.ValidationRequest.params.requestURI: The URI of the off-chain data to validate.
fn.ValidationRequest.params.requestHash: The keccak256 commitment identifying the request.
sim.registerAgentWalkthrough.name: Register Agent Walkthrough
sim.registerAgentWalkthrough.desc: Follow a register call from the owner through agent storage to the Registered event.
sim.registerAgentWalkthrough.step.call: The owner calls register(agentURI) on the Identity Registry to mint a new agent token.
sim.registerAgentWalkthrough.step.execut: The registry assigns an incrementing agentId, records the owner and registration URI, and sets the reserved agentWallet metadata to the owner.
sim.registerAgentWalkthrough.step.event: The registry emits Registered(agentId, agentURI, owner) so explorers and indexers can pick up the new agent.
